description: This file contains FastAPI route handlers for managing 'activities' in a finance-related client relationship management system. It includes endpoints to list, create, retrieve, update, and delete activity records, utilizing a SQLAlchemy ORM for database operations.

methods.name: _paginate(query, page: int, page_size: int)

methods.name: ActivityOut get_activity(activity_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))

methods.name: ActivityOut update_activity(activity_id: int, payload: ActivityUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to update an existing activity, with validation for client existence if client_id is changed.

methods.name: None delete_activity(activity_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to delete an activity record by ID.
